summary: DS2-R2 is resolved: the root pnpm importer now supplies an exact version before package entries/package.json, and the tested malformed YAML forms produce lockfile_unreadable. The implementation still silently accepts arbitrary non-lockfile content for yarn.lock and pnpm-lock.yaml, contrary to the required invalid-or-unparseable-lockfile diagnostic. This is the third rejected review cycle, so DS-2 is blocked for a human decision under the program rule.

findings.title: Do not silently treat arbitrary non-lockfile content as a valid lockfile
findings.detail: yamlLikeIsMalformed only catches a few syntax patterns. A yarn.lock or pnpm-lock.yaml containing arbitrary non-lockfile text returns no lockfile_unreadable check and falls back to package.json. Validate the expected lockfile structure (or use a parser) so unparseable content always produces lockfile_unreadable before fallback, with regression fixtures for both managers.
